strings.name: Lawrence Wong
strings.summary: Wong moved from the civil service and economic policy into politics, holding culture, national-development and education portfolios and co-chairing the COVID-19 taskforce. He became Singapore’s fourth prime minister in 2024 while retaining finance, then became People’s Action Party secretary-general. A new term followed the 2025 election, with social support, economic transition and digital government among his priorities.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
